title: Personal Agent：从完成任务到承担事务
title_en: Personal agents: from finishing tasks to carrying ongoing responsibilities
summary: 近两个月 Personal Agent 产品密集发布。本文从一篇产品定位分析出发，讨论个人代理在记忆、主动服务、长期执行与授权上需要解决的问题，以及如何评估它的真实价值。
summary_en: Personal agents have shipped in quick succession over the past two months. Starting from a product-positioning analysis, this note looks at what memory, proactivity, long-running execution, and authorization require, and how to judge the real value.

title: 从 DeepSeek Super-agent 看 Agent 的下一步
title_en: What DeepSeek’s Super-agent says about where agents go next
summary: DeepSeek 近期公开了 Super-agent 的设计文章与研究原型。本文分析这套设计的价值、尚待解决的问题，以及社区讨论中的主要分歧。
summary_en: DeepSeek recently published its Super-agent design and a research prototype. This note examines what the design offers, what remains unresolved, and where the community disagrees.
